description: Define YjjW iron-sulfur sites from sequence motifs and verify each in the AlphaFold model
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seqs=json.load(open("activase_seqs.json"))
ACC={'YjjW_ECOLI':'P39409','BssD_THAAR':'O87941','PflA_ECOLI':'P0A9N4','NrdG_ECOLI':'P0A9N8'}

def sgs(acc):
    sg={}; pl={}
    for L in open(f"AF-{acc}.pdb"):
        if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[17:20].strip()=="CYS" and L[12:16].strip()=="SG":
            sg[int(L[22:26])]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
            pl[int(L[22:26])]=float(L[60:66])
    return sg,pl

# Sites are defined from the two canonical motifs, then checked geometrically.
# Single-linkage clustering alone chains the two adjacent ferredoxin sites together,
# so the motif definition is used and the compactness of each site is reported.
def sites_from_motifs(s):
    out=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=C...C..C)', s):      # CxxxCxxC, radical SAM
        i=m.start()+1; out.append(('radical SAM', [i,i+4,i+7]))
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=C..C..C...C)', s):   # CxxCxxCxxxC, ferredoxin
        i=m.start()+1; out.append(('ferredoxin', [i,i+3,i+6,i+10]))
    return out

rows=[]
for n,acc in ACC.items():
    sg,pl=sgs(acc)
    for kind,cs in sites_from_motifs(seqs[n]):
        if not all(c in sg for c in cs):
            rows.append(dict(protein=n,acc=acc,type=kind,site="+".join(f"C{c}" for c in cs),
                             n_Cys=len(cs),max_SG_SG=np.nan,mean_pLDDT=np.nan,compact=False)); continue
        d=[np.linalg.norm(sg[a]-sg[b]) for i,a in enumerate(cs) for b in cs[i+1:]]
        rows.append(dict(protein=n,acc=acc,type=kind,site="+".join(f"C{c}" for c in cs),
                         n_Cys=len(cs),max_SG_SG=round(max(d),2),
                         mean_pLDDT=round(float(np.mean([pl[c] for c in cs])),1),
                         compact=max(d)<=8.0,
                         cen=np.mean([sg[c] for c in cs],axis=0)))
S=pd.DataFrame(rows)
S.drop(columns=['cen']).to_csv("activase_FeS_sites.csv",index=False)
print("Iron-sulfur sites defined by motif and verified in the AlphaFold v6 models")
print("(a [4Fe-4S] site has all Cys SG atoms within about 7 A of each other):\n")
print(S[['protein','type','site','n_Cys','max_SG_SG','mean_pLDDT','compact']].to_string(index=False))

cnt=S[S.compact].groupby('protein').size().reindex(['YjjW_ECOLI','BssD_THAAR','PflA_ECOLI','NrdG_ECOLI']).fillna(0).astype(int)
print("\nCompact [4Fe-4S] sites per activase:"); print(cnt.to_string())

print("\nCentre-to-centre distances between sites:")
for n in ACC:
    d=S[(S.protein==n)&(S.compact)]
    C=list(d['cen']); lab=list(d['site'])
    if len(C)<2: print(f"  {n:12s} single site"); continue
    for i in range(len(C)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(C)):
            print(f"  {n:12s} {lab[i]:20s} to {lab[j]:20s} {np.linalg.norm(C[i]-C[j]):5.1f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,4.3))
ax.bar([x.split('_')[0] for x in cnt.index], cnt.values,
       color=['#c53030','#2b6cb0','#718096','#718096'])
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.values): ax.text(i,v+0.06,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('[4Fe-4S] sites verified in the model')
ax.set_title('YjjW carries three cysteine-ligated [4Fe-4S] sites, matching BssD\n'
             'PflA and NrdG carry only the radical SAM site')
ax.set_ylim(0,3.6); ax.grid(alpha=.3,axis='y')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
